translations.web: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.
translations.bsb: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.
translations.kjv: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
